name: Local Grove Pre-Roll | Brain Stew | 1G
description:
Genetics: Triangle Kush x Runtz
Breeder: Clearwater Genetics
Selected by: Local Grove (seed hunt, in-house pheno)
Aroma & Flavor: Creamy undertones with berry candy sweetness
Effects: Balanced hybrid – uplifting yet smooth with a relaxing finish
Awards: 1st Place – 2022 Michigan High Times Cannabis Cup
Dense, compact buds with a creamy undertone and sweet berry-candy finish make Brain Stew one of the crown jewels of Local Grove. This strain earned First Place at the 2022 Michigan High Times Cannabis Cup, solidifying its reputation as a true connoisseur’s choice. Expect a balanced hybrid experience — uplifting and flavorful with a smooth, lingering sweetness.
